newsitem.title: USA: Chrysler raises suggested prices on some models.
newsitem.headline: Chrysler raises suggested prices on some models.

text.p: Chrysler Corp on Friday said it raised the suggested retail price of some 1997 vehicles by $30 to as much as $200.

The increases, which will be applied beginning with vehicles shipped January 7, range from $30 on Dodge Stratus and Plymouth Breeze, to $200 on all-wheel-drive models of Dodge Grand Caravan and Chrysler Town & Country.
Price increases on some options also take effect January 7. Those options are carried as standard equipment on many of the vehicles whose base prices are being raised, the company said.

In addition, prices for entry-level Dodge and Plymouth Neon have been revised to reflect addition of an AM/FM radio with four speakers and dual remote exterior mirrors as standard equipment. Since the autumn, all entry-level Neons have been produced with the extra equipment, so the base price increase will result in no change to the current delivered price.
By early afternoon, Chrysler shares were up 1/4 at 34 in trading on the New York Stock Exchange.
